high_level_description: This image is a graphical representation comparing the wavelength ranges of light that the Hubble Telescope and the Webb Telescope can detect. The background is dark purple, which gives a professional and scientific tone to the image. The main title at the top reads: "Hubble's vision is limited to visible and ultraviolet." Below the title, there is a horizontal bar representing the electromagnetic spectrum, which includes gamma rays, X-rays, ultraviolet (UV), visible light, infrared, microwave, and radio waves.
